payload.instance: uuid — the battlemap instance the token stands on, when the command names no target; never written
payload.token: uuid — the token moved, a token of that instance (instance-isolated); never written, the move lands on the token's own row
payload.q: integer — the axial column of the hex it is dropped on (HexGrid@1)
payload.r: integer — the axial row of the hex it is dropped on (HexGrid@1)
